title: Shared-edge local circuit, refined bit frames and bit terminal sinks on PR168 v4 (κ = 6.60216552061722e-4)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Two changes above PR168 v4 (prerequisite `4a3c769e5c5430e7114c4d3e099ff34664677f17`). **Complex:** change the per-cube local channel circuit: the local sums $A[1,0]$, $A[1,1]$ and $A[2,1]$ are assembled from direction-0 edge sums, which the $G[1,2,0]$ channel already computes, instead of edges along directions 2, 2 and 1. The circuit has 29 additions per cube instead of 27, but the carrier closure admits 11,364 arcs instead of 10,704, so the virtual auxiliary stock falls from 13,372 to 13,042 roles. All modules, fused outputs and schedules of PR168 are retained; the carrier matching, gauge selection, endpoint frame descent, 2,310 compensated handoffs and 44 terminal-output deletions are regenerated for the new graph (this part is my #181). **Bit:** keep PR168's bit graph, modules and 1,760 aliases, replace 556 operation frames of its physical layer by connected-component endpoint moves (3,368 frames now differ from the compiler frames), and delete 34 face0 terminal sinks by James Chang's PR166 substitution, rechecked on the overridden word. Both suppliers and the paid balanced composition are independently certified. Under the retained interfaces, the bound is

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{330108276030861}{5\cdot10^{17}}
=0.000660216552061722.
$$

This is +0.66% over PR168 v4 (6.558894e-4) and +0.16% over my #181 (6.591806e-4), which it supersedes (#181 remains the complex-only step). The refined complex profile has 10,688 physical auxiliary roles, 13,328 persistent roles, rank mass 878,328, deficit 1,320 and largest child 20; its saving is $132438677973/(2\cdot10^{14})=0.000662193389865$. The refined bit profile has 17,994 physical roles, 21,514 persistent roles, rank mass 1,547,072, deficit 1,936 and largest child 60; its coarse saving is $41316503191007/(625\cdot10^{14})=0.000661064051056$ (PR168 v4: $6600253/10^{10}$), and the established atom wrapper gives ordinary saving approximately 0.000660652725927. **The bit branch still binds**, below the complex saving 0.000662193389865.

The configurable circuit is icekylinx's (PR144); the complex part only selects a different configuration by a coordinate search over the 3^13 options (single-entry neighbours in three rounds plus pair/triple combinations, scored by the numerical physical root). Carrier arcs come from our own legal-edge Hopcroft–Karp matching on coordinate-padded frames, extended by DaysSky's PR162 rule, and are replayed by the retained `compile_closure` with its acyclicity and span checks. The bit frame moves follow PR131's descent rule (each frame between the join of its incoming frames and the meet of its outgoing frames) on exact rational subspaces, repaired to nondegenerate bases; the 34 sinks are the face0 roots whose rank-21 caps contain every write, with the complete modified target chronology, all 17,994 dirty columns over F2 and over the integers, and exact prime witnesses for all 24,577 used frames. Scalar virtual stock, compensated handoffs, terminal deletions, the full orthogonal-group cardinality and all row reserves are charged separately. The exact four-file PR175 overlay at `f1081fabbfadaaaaf7292a40d428dbbb865ce920` is retained in the verification baseline.

No mathematical hypothesis or ordinary-supplier interface is strengthened. General Clifford/tensor, uniform weighted compilation, restored-row, paid-layout, precision/recovery and analytic fixed-tape contracts remain the stated assumptions. The finite certificate is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude and OpenAI Codex assistance. The prerequisite construction is eumemic's PR168 v4, retaining its Anthropic Claude/OpenAI Codex disclosures and earlier PR144/161 lineage. Terminal-output accumulation is James Chang's PR166; balanced-layout, atom-toll and earlier supplier attribution remain in `research/paired-cube-local-bit-168/NOTICE`. PR154 supplies the isolated verification technique; PR175 supplies the exact compiler overlay.

## Validation

Validated exact commit `af90b94783f7d104a0be75c762ade758bec75855` (tree `2d1ff185ea834ac2e05d8bb3a965b1791590be9b`).

- The new signed graph passes the exact scalar identity, carrier closure and frame audits. Complete original and terminal-modified complex words pass in both directions, including every source/target/dirty formal column and the full target-frame chronology. The modified word checks 13,328 columns and restores all 10,688 dirty roles; three corruption controls are rejected.
- The published PR168 v4 bit layer is reproduced, the overridden layer passes all 21,548 F2 and defining-integer-decoder columns, and the terminal-modified word passes all 17,994 dirty plus 3,520 data columns over F2 and over the integers with three sink controls rejected. All 24,577 used frame Gram witnesses preserve the retained prime range; word and factor controls are rejected.
- Exact supplier moments, full scalar/group/router/row formulas, all 47 strict inequalities and seven margins pass. Independent arithmetic reproduces the same bound with 30 rejected mutations; the package retains 21 assembly controls. Adjacent grid exclusions concern only the fixed certificates and parameters.
- The read-only aggregate reproduces the canonical certificate. `SOURCE.json` pins 1,699 files plus its own separately reported digest; every prerequisite file is retained except the exact four-file PR175 overlay.
- **Full repository gate: PASS. All 14 native verification groups plus the selected package passed in isolated copies of the published tree using the PR154 technique (Linux); every source file remained byte-identical.**
- **GitHub CI: all 45 checks passed on the exact commit above, including the Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14 matrices and all formal checks.**

Canonical finite check:

```sh
python3 -B research/paired-cube-local-bit-168/verify.py
```
